column6: Say to my lord: thus says @wPN{Aradŋu}, your servant:

My lord, you have given me instructions about every matter, from the sea and the land of @wGN{Dilmun}, @varh[t3103.v1]{from the salt waters and the borders of the land of the @wEN{Martu} } @vart[t3103.v2,t3103.v1]{@varn{some mss. have instead:} to the salt waters and the borders of the land of the @wEN{Martu} }, @varh[t3103.v3]{to } @vart[t3103.v4,t3103.v3]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} from } the @varh[t3103.v5]{side } @vart[t3103.v6,t3103.v5]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} borders } of @wSN{Simurrum} and @varh[t3103.v7]{the territory of …… } @vart[t3103.v8,t3103.v7]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} the territory of @wGN{Subir} }:

Their various cities and @varh[t3103.v9]{all their environs } @vart[t3103.v10,t3103.v9]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} their troops }, their canals, fields, arable tracts and their embankments and ditches, @gap{1 line unclear} All the cities are listening to my lord. @gap{1 line unclear}
I have established strong guards for their fortresses, and I have made all their troops submit. @gap{1 line unclear}

I have drained the arable tracts when they were flooded. I have …… when their embankments were leaky. I have …… their fields and reedbeds. …… bowing their heads ……. @gap{4 lines fragmentary} @gap{unknown no. of lines missing}
